premise.claim: Dependabot: "Bumps github.com/klauspost/compress from 1.17.11 to 1.18.7"; v1.18.7 is a security release ("Fix s2.NewDict OOB read"), so the base pin v1.17.11 is flagged as vulnerable.
premise.reportedComponent: github.com/klauspost/compress module version pinned in go.mod/go.sum (vendored)
premise.patchedComponent: go.mod, go.sum, vendor/github.com/klauspost/compress/** — the only in-build consumer is prometheus/client_golang promhttp -> zstd, reached via controller-runtime metrics servers in all Fluid controller binaries
premise.evidence: Base 86e3adf3 pins v1.17.11, inside GO-2026-5841 / GHSA-259r-337f-4rfw (CVE-2026-63209) range [1.16.0, 1.18.7); so the version-level alert is real. Reachability caveat: the advisory affects only the s2 package, which is NOT vendored on base or head (no vendor/github.com/klauspost/compress/s2, no importer in the graph) — the vulnerable code is never compiled into Fluid binaries. See results/premise-base.out and results/osv.json.

liveNote: L3 not needed: the claim is decided by unit + integration layers (real HTTP negotiation via httptest). No cluster required. Optional live signal if desired: scrape a real Fluid controller metrics port with 'curl -H "Accept-Encoding: zstd" http://<metrics>/metrics | zstd -d' and compare with the identity response.
